description: Destructive card that requires typing the workspace name before deletion is enabled.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { Trash2Icon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" import { Input } from "@workspace/ui/components/input" const workspace = "acme-marketing" export default function DangerZoneCard() { const [value, setValue] = React.useState("") return ( Delete workspace This permanently removes 38 projects, 1,204 files and all member access. This can't be undone. Type {workspace} to confirm setValue(e.target.value)} autoComplete="off" /> ) }
